title: Roadmap
intro_md: What's being built now and what comes after. No dates: the work ships when its reviews and checks pass.

items.title: Dante's Inferno's loop skip
items.detail_md: A skip for the loop in which Dante's Inferno waits, doing nothing, for its next frame. It goes into the PSP core once its reviews and frame-by-frame exactness checks pass.

items.title: Hotkeys on Android and the desktop
items.detail_md: The owner's pull request [#294](https://github.com/pwnedbygary/phobos/pull/294): combos of any length, three bindings per action, per-console and per-game levels, slow motion and frame advance.

items.title: The GE thread's automatic handover
items.detail_md: An Auto mode for the GE thread, handing over both ways, that keeps a game synchronous where the two threads would only take turns. Then the app's "PSP Graphics Overlap" switch, once On beats Off on the Retroid Pocket 6.

items.title: Live switching for the PSP
items.detail_md: Changing the PSP's resolution and renderer mid-game, without a restart. It waited for the GE thread and timing work, which has now merged.

items.title: Vulkan (accurate), faster
items.detail_md: Bringing the accurate Vulkan renderer's speed closer to the fast one's on the handheld.
